vi. World Health Organisation and UNHCR recommend EMDR for acute
stress & PTSD
“EMDR is an advanced psychological intervention for stress and PTSD.
Like CBT-T, EMDR aims to reduce subjective distress and strengthen adaptive beliefs related to the
traumatic event. Unlike CBT-T, EMDR does not involve (a) detailed descriptions of the event, (b)
direct challenging of beliefs, (c) extended exposure or (d) homework.”
